all.src: All three legs same expiry, OI >= 250 each, combined spread <= 1.5% of net debit.

exits.src: HARD: close the entire structure by 15:30 ET on expiration day. Auto-exercise of the two ITM longs plus assignment of the short creates a net +100 share position (or worse if the short is also ITM) that the account may not want.
Close the short call immediately if its extrinsic < 0.05 and delta > 0.85 - assignment of the short call delivers SHORT shares against long calls.

safety_gaps.why: the document names a stop and none compiled. A strategy that looks armed and is missing its stop is the failure this whole pipeline exists to prevent.
